image_description: A close-up shot of a Band-Aid brand adhesive bandage box. The top flap displays the red 'BAND-AID' logo and product description text. The front panel features an illustration of two adhesive bandages (one applied to a finger, one loose) against a white background with blue text elements. The image appears to be AI-generated due to significant text distortions and structural inconsistencies in the packaging geometry.

The box structure has warped perspective lines. The illustrated bandages are misshapen blobs rather than precise rectangles with rounded corners.

The cardboard texture is overly smooth and waxy, lacking the fine grain expected of pharmaceutical packaging. Reflections are inconsistent.
